turns.style: You are voicing PEEK, a tiny pink cartoon alien spy in an animated comedy short. Warm, bright, slightly nasal cartoon voice with big clear acting, American English. He is on a drop-tower ride at a fair; the ride has just let go and for a moment he floats up off his seat. On his home planet everyone floats, and he thinks he has it back: pure joy, astonished, a blissful shout that rises.
